title: GitHub main policy validation is portable across clean checkouts
user_action: Create a detached clean worktree from origin/main and run the repository policy verifier.

expected_results.repository: The verifier accepts a clean main checkout at an arbitrary filesystem path.
expected_results.history: The original mobile history remains an ancestor of the checked-out commit.
expected_results.privacy: Forbidden runtime, account, ledger, and secret-shaped files remain absent from tracked source.
expected_results.recovery: The public checkout validates the recovery manifest without requiring private external backup artifacts to be copied into Git.
